source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 30 mai — «Sfântul Cuvios Varlaam»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ής Μαΐου — «Όσιος Βαρλαάμ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and the Greek entry is as bare as the Romanian one: «Ο Όσιος Βαρλαάμ απεβίωσε ειρηνικά», he died peacefully, with no epithet, no place and no year. It is the same entry on the same day of the same menologion, with the same rank and the same absence of everything else, and that is the ground for the row; the folder's slug keeps the day for exactly this reason, there being four other Barlaams in the corpus and nothing on either page to tell this one apart by. No `dates`, and no hymn — only the distich «Tον Bαρλαάμ έγνωκε και τα γης άκρα, Άκρως ενασκήσαντα μέχρι γην έδυ.», which the folder does not take as a service.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
